title: Math Encounters -- Five Balls, Two Hands: The Patterns of Juggling -- Colin Wright (Presentation)
summary: Mathematician Colin Wright demonstrates juggling and explains the mathematics of juggling patterns, including notation that led to new throwing patterns. It is a public presentation at the Museum of Mathematics aimed at a general audience.
why: HN recommends it as an entertaining way to learn math through juggling.

quote.text: my fondness for this video that uses juggling to good effect to teach math in an entertaining way
